thread:
pat: quick note from trying to onboard a contractor today — our sample app instructions say set REDWOOD_API_KEY but our new proj-scoped flow expects REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN. total confusion, tests passed locally then CI failed.

erin: classic. do we have a backwards compatibility plan? lots of orgs already named secrets REDWOOD_API_KEY in GH.

pat: i made a tiny repro: docker-compose with host env REDWOOD_API_KEY and a .env with REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN. runtime picked the org key without warning.

jules: sdk should prioritize explicit project token. existing order (API_KEY > PROJECT_TOKEN) was historical. propose: SDK reads in this order: 1) REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN, 2) REDWOOD_CLI_EPHEMERAL, 3) REDWOOD_API_KEY (legacy). emit a single WARN on startup if legacy var present and a project token is also present.

maya: agree. also display the active scope in `rw whoami` and add a `--show-env` flag to reveal which env var was used (redact value). small dev DX win.

erin: can we add a migration helper in sample apps that logs "found legacy REDWOOD_API_KEY; consider migrating to REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN" and prints a docker-compose.override snippet to set project token?

pat: i sketched one:
```yaml
# docker-compose.override.env.sample
REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN=${REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN}
# fallback for legacy(secret):
# REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN=${REDWOOD_API_KEY}
```
works for quick fixes.

jules: rotation guidance: recommend per-project long-lived tokens for CI (rotate monthly) and ephemeral CLI tokens for local dev via `rw auth login --ttl=1h`. docs should show k8s secret rotation pattern: write new key to secret, then `kubectl rollout restart` or use sidecar that hot-swaps envs. add sample k8s manifest.

kube-team: note: many charts mount secrets as keys like `redwood.api.key` (dots) — our samples use `redwood.project_token` (underscore). can we standardize and provide a compatibility map in docs?
\ermaybe: (typo intentional) maya: yes standardize on `redwood.project_token` for clarity. kube-team can map existing keys during migration. we'll publish a migration snippet for Helm values.

erin: tests: add unit tests for env precedence in node/python/go. also add a CI e2e that runs sample app with different env combos to catch regressions.

jules: SDK API: expose `redwood.config.getActiveKeyName()` returning the env var identifier (e.g., REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN) so tooling can show it. and `redwood.auth.onKeyAmbiguous(callback)` to let apps surface friendly UI.

pat: one more: signal token TTL to apps. when token TTL < 5m, SDK emits a WARN and metric `redwood.auth.token_near_expiry`. CI can fail early instead of hitting mysterious auth errors mid-run.

cli-bot: Created ticket DEVX-8461: "Env var precedence, naming standard, and rotation docs" with repro, proposed SDK changes, and sample app PR checklist.

maya: thanks. jules/erin — can you land the SDK change behind a feature flag so sample apps can be updated first? then flip default after one week of telemetry.

jules: yep will add `REDWOOD_ENV_PRECEDENCE_V2=true` behind flag and tests. will also add a one-line startup log explaining precedence.

kube-team: we'll update Helm charts and kube operator docs. will coordinate a migration window and add a script to rename secrets in-place where safe.

pat: will update sample app README + onboarding checklist and link the migration script. closing when SDK flag + sample PRs merge. :rocket:
